QuestInfo.name: News of Vikin's Return
QuestInfo.0: The #p9010000# says that she has some interesting news. What could it be?
QuestInfo.1: The Administrator says that #b#p9000009##k recently returned from a long voyage and brought back lots of Treasure Chests. Treasure Chests... what could be inside? Go see #b#p9000009##k and find out.
QuestInfo.2: #p9000009#, who returned from his voyage, seemed very tired but was still in a good mood thanks to all the Treasure Chests he acquired.

0.0: Have you heard the news? #b#p9000009##k came back from his voyage with a ton of treasure chests. Sounds like he found them on a desert island... What could be inside them? Could you go find out from #b#p900009##k?
그 이야기 들으셨어요? 얼마 전 오랜 항해를 떠났던 #b#p9000009##k씨가 돌아왔다고 하더군요. 그런데 이번 여행에서 엄청나게 많은 보물상자를 얻었다고 하더라구요. 어느 외딴 섬에서 발견했다는데 과연 그 보물상자에는 어떤 보물들이 들어있을까요? 궁금하지 않으세요? #b#p9000009##k씨를 한번 찾아가보시는건 어때요?

1.0: 오랫만이군. 그동안 잘 지냈나? 오래간만에 땅을 밟으니 왠지 어색한 것 같아. 역시 난 바다 위에 있을 때가 편하다구. 하하하하! 오랜 항해로 조금 지치긴 했지만 어느새 다시 바다가 그립군.
